lines: With the twilight streets behind me, those days when we could hold each other brush across my chest
Careless words sometimes wounded people, and now you're gone
Lately, the pitiful man reflected in the window is dear to me too
Ah, still as I am, holding a dream I won't give up
I'll keep walking on and on — that's all right, isn't it?
Mr.myself
Every day, the melody flowing through this heart
Lightly, gently, it runs through me
Before I climb the sunlit slope
I hope we can meet again somewhere
Innocent world
These days even dinner-table talk is tainted by work
Looking at things from every angle, I lost sight of myself
In these tangled relationships I'm always balancing the books
Ah, still as you are, in your quiet life
Sometimes it's fine to let yourself go with the wind
Oh Miss yourself
Struck by the listless June rain
I sing, yearning for a season filled with love
Showing a smile I'd forgotten without noticing
I'll cast these swaying feelings toward the far side of the rainbow
In a corner of the ever-changing city, fragments of dreams are born
Oh, at any moment now
And I'll go on as I am, with a faint light in my chest
I intend to press on tomorrow too — that's all right, isn't it?
Mr.myself
Every day, the melody flowing through this heart
Bittersweet and tender — my heart aches
Before I climb the sunlit slope
I hope we can meet again somewhere
Then we'll smile, and cast them toward the far side of the rainbow
Innocent world
Stretching on without end, innocent world
